candidate_experiment_id: EXP-P18-002 was suggested in docs/reviews/PM-intake-research-2026-10-03.md; collisions across branches are NOT verified. The PM assigns the id, moves this file to configs/<id>.yaml, sets status REGISTERED and execution.enabled true. The runner refuses UNASSIGNED and DRAFT for a full run (a --smoke is allowed from the draft).
origin: Drafted 2026-10-03 after the EXP-P17-001 (D152) and EXP-P18-001 (D155) results were read. The variant list and the descriptive reading below are P18-informed: they are registered, if at all, after those observations and are not prospectively registered relative to them. Candidate seeds 3 and 4 were proposed in the PM research intake; seed 2 is a registered planning seed (seeds.planning_v2).
purpose: Measure how stable the frozen G0 P3 law (tau 0.1) is to the planner's search seed and sample count on the sealed June tau-design decisions, with the predictor, reference law, support, pools, WE and states unchanged. Extends EXP-P18-001 (one alternative seed) to several seeds and to a doubled sample count, so the D155 side observation (seed-only top-1 change 11.3%) becomes a measured range. Descriptive only: no verdict, no gate, no policy value.
one_change: Planner search seed and sample count per variant (see variants). Everything else equals EXP-P18-001: predictor G0 bound through the registered chain, reference law, support table, delivery pools, WE terminal/cutoff, tau, pitch cap, decision states.

order: smoke : --output <runs>/<id>-smoke --smoke   (three games, 20-decision replay; no repository result)
run   : --output <runs>/<id>                 (all sealed decisions; writes sealed.npz, decisions-<label>.npz, results.json)
aggregate offline with the command above; the aggregate report is the candidate repository result (PM decides)
execution.queue: single heavy queue: runs/ML-MATRIX-20260924/.heavy.lock (non-blocking); Mac mini only, A5000 not used; obey D159 (no overlap with game recording windows) and the OPS freeze
execution.expected_cost: ESTIMATE, not measured for this runner: EXP-P18-001 measured 1,965 s and peak RSS 7.2 GB for one seed at 6 samples over 40,702 decisions. Three 6-sample variants plus two 12-sample variants, computed per decision in one process, scale to roughly 3 x 1,965 s + 2 x ~3,930 s = about 3.8 h plus the 200-decision replay. Laws saved per variant add about 3.3 MB each. A smaller first registration (for example seed2-s6 and seed0-s12 only, about 1.6 h) is possible; the PM chooses the subset before registration.
execution.smoke_status: NOT run in the drafting session (no real-data execution was authorised). Required before registration. A smoke may be run from this DRAFT file as is (the runner accepts DRAFT/UNASSIGNED only with --smoke and only into an output ending -smoke); a full run needs the assigned id, REGISTERED status, execution.enabled true and the file at configs/<id>.yaml.

policy_registration.use: read-only: sealed BC, support table, style snapshot, S2-certified component identity and the tau freeze are resolved through the registered chain; no stage of that chain is run and nothing is added to it

sealed_g0_run.use: the G0 side of the comparison: recorded planning Q, mask and reference law of every evaluated decision (June 2025, 150 games)

variant_notes.seed_basis: planning_main = the sealed seed; planning_v2 = a seed named in the policy registration (seeds.planning_v2 = [0, 1, 2]); extension = not a registered planning seed, used only for this descriptive diagnostic and never as a policy identity field
variant_notes.seed0-s12: keeps the sealed seed: numpy draws sequentially, so its 12 samples contain the sealed 6 as a prefix (shares_prefix_draws). Its distance to the sealed law measures the effect of adding six draws, not an independent-seed distance.
variant_notes.seed1-s12: seed 1 was the EXP-P18-001 noise seed at 6 samples; at 12 samples it answers whether a doubled search narrows the seed distance (compare with the EXP-P18-001 row in the aggregate).

replay.rule: the first 200 evaluated decisions are recomputed with the sealed setting (seed 0, 6 samples) and must reproduce the sealed planning Q; every regenerated request must carry the sealed fingerprint, mask, reference law and context hash

row_budget_basis: safety cap on simulated rows per variant planner (a budget changes failures, never probabilities); EXP-P18-001 measured 3,805,035 rows for one 6-sample variant, so a 12-sample variant is expected near 7.6M. The runner refuses a cap below 1.2 x 3,805,035 x (largest samples / 6) = 9,132,084 for this variant list; a budget overflow hours into a full run would lose the run (nothing is saved before the end).

quantities: per variant: mean TV to the sealed law with a whole-game bootstrap interval, top-1 agreement, TV quantiles, share above 0.05
across fixed-predictor variants: pairwise mean TV, share of decisions whose top-1 pitch type is unanimous (sealed included), mean modal agreement
by sample count: mean TV to the sealed law at 6 and 12 samples (nesting flagged per row)
support coverage: decisions compared / sealed evaluated decisions, mean supported actions, share with a single supported action
reading.no_verdict: No threshold, verdict or stop rule is attached. The EXP-P17-001 (DIFFERENT_RECOMMENDATIONS) and EXP-P18-001 (WITHIN_SEARCH_NOISE) verdicts stay as registered. A report of these numbers is not a policy utility estimate, not a re-validation and not a service adoption basis.
reading.report_contract: The aggregate report separates fixed-predictor seed variability, sample-count variants and predictor replacement (EXP-P17-001 rows, carried through), states the paired-uncertainty limits (one sealed side shared by all rows; CRN inside the swap comparison but not inside seed comparisons; prefix nesting), reports supported-action coverage, and records outcomes_read = false.

data_rules: No 2026 rows. June 2025 blend-split rows of the sealed tau-design sample only; pre-decision fields, logged pitch types and previous-row outcomes as history. No reward, WE result, events kind or next-row state.
review: Drafted by Claude Fable 5.1 (worker) on 2026-10-03; synthetic tests only. PM review required for: id assignment and collision check, variant subset and cost against the D159 window, smoke on real inputs, row budget, and whether the aggregate report becomes a repository result. Independent review gate not passed.
